desc: The full-depth dual fuel slide-in range fits into any freestanding range cutout and has five burners, allowing you to cook many items at once. A large oven capacity of 4.6 cubic feet fits most pots and pans while 11 specialized cooking modes allow for gourmet cooking made easy.
hl: A Warming Drawer beneath the oven provides extra storage, and keeps your food warm until it's ready to serve.
The slide-in design can replace a freestanding range cutout and slides back against the wall for a sleek built-in look.
With all the cooking you'll do in a Bosch oven, clean-up should be your last worry.
A special enameling process allows the grates to be washed directly in the dishwasher instead of by hand for easier clean up.
Continuous Cast Iron Grates allows you to easily slide heavy pots and pans from burner to burner.
spec: Proof, Roast, Convection Roast, Bake, Convection Bake, Pizza, Convection Multi-Rack, Convection Broil, Broil, Warm, Warming Drawer
